publish.description: pb-os tools for Game Mode, in tabs (LB/RB switch them): updates from the GitHub releases, a microSD card or USB drive, or the Downloads folder; moving SteamOS from the microSD card to internal storage and back; stick lights; the charging indicator (stick lights while the device sleeps on the charger); Proton PB-OS for every game on Valve's Proton; face-button layout for physically moved caps; stick calibration and fine stick steps (Retroid Pocket 6 / Nova, AYN Thor); Barry Launcher on or off in Desktop Mode (AYN Thor); on the KONKR Pocket FIT also the performance profile, fan and buttons.
